summary: Feature request to track current heartbeat timeout while retrying failed heartbeat calls in HeartbeatContextImpl, and stop retrying if the activity is suspected to have timed out. Activity code should be notified via ActivityCompletionException or a new exception type.
userImpact: Activity code cannot determine whether heartbeat failures are due to activity timeout, leading to continued retry attempts after the activity has already timed out.
proposedFix: Track current heartbeat timeout for the activity and cease retry attempts if timeout is suspected; notify activity via ActivityCompletionException or new exception type
keyQuote: Feature request is for SDK to keep track of current heartbeat timeout for activity, and stop retrying heartbeats if it thinks the activity has timed out
